scope: Independent Python authoring validation; no simulator import or dynamics run
limitations: Hardware dimensions, masses, motor limits and contact coefficients are not measured by this validator.
Collision screening uses primitive oriented bounds; cylinder and mesh candidates may be false positives.
One-joint sweeps do not prove collision freedom for simultaneous multi-joint motion.

zero_pose_support_polygon.method: Static COM projection within polygon of contact centers, ignoring finite contact-patch size

r08_dimension_register_check.source: Independently transcribed R08 construction constants and explicit provisional simulation geometry; checked against source register and URDF transforms/colliders

source_categories.manufacturer_envelope: WR141E exterior 558x404x205mm only; not a measured body surface
source_categories.supplied_stock: Four 20x20x500mm posts; sixteen 200mm rails cut to 160mm
source_categories.approved_construction_change: 200x200mm frame and floors, 204x204mm externally covered body, 160x160mm clear opening, black frame/front/sides, internal casing-free camera reservation
source_categories.provisional_unmeasured_simulation_inputs: Bare-camera module fit, PCB/optics/heat-sink sizes, camera optical calibration, retained 970g camera mass budget, wheel/caster geometry, chassis/frame mounting datum, arm pivots and all mass/actuator values

r08_dimension_register_check.limitations: Confirms internal consistency with nominal R08 construction and declared provisional inputs. Does not verify physical hardware, as-built tolerances, payload, mounting strength or real-world dynamics.

paired_mirror_fk.method: Matched left/right joints receive equal nonzero scalar commands; origins and conjugate reflected basis matrices must match

collision_screening.method: Oriented bounding box SAT; adjacent links and explicit allowed pairs excluded

estimated_static_gravity_loads.limitations: Based on declared estimated masses; ignores payload, acceleration, friction, gear efficiency and multi-joint combinations.

publication_note: Local authoring paths normalized to package-relative paths; results and tested model hashes unchanged.
